messages.subject: ggplot label annotation for plot matrix
parts:
I am a Statistician at Lilly, and I am stuck on a problem I am having
with your ggplot2 package. Below is some code that I’ve been working
with. My code produces a matrix of plots with incorrect labels. Now,
what I’m stuck on is trying to get the blue- and red- point panels to
have different text values (for example, “a11” will become “a12” on
row 2 and “a21” will become “a22” on row 2, and “a11” will become
“a13” on row 3, etc…).

My code is as follows:

START OF CODE:

library(ggplot2)
library (reshape2)
library(grid)
library(plyr)
library(TeachingDemos)
library(gridBase)
library(lattice)
library(gplots)
library(gdata)

scatter<-read.table("c:\\temp\\test_data.txt", header=T)

plotting.routine <- function(p){

level<-levels(factor(p$treatment))
n<-length(levels(factor(p$treatment)))

values<-as.character(level)
values[values=="1"] <- "1"
values[values=="2"] <- "2"
values[values=="3"] <- "3"
values[values=="4"] <- "4"


### Assign Color

col <- as.character(values)
col[col=="1"] <- rgb(56,111,11,max=255) # green
col[col=="2"] <- rgb(31,73,125,max=255) # blue
col[col=="3"] <- rgb(218,51,38,max=255) # red
col[col=="4"] <- rgb(120,120,120,max=255) # grey


### Assign Point Shape

ps <- as.character(values)
# ps[ps=="1"] <- 5 # hollow diamond
ps[ps=="1"] <- 18 # diamond
ps[ps=="2"] <- 15 # square
ps[ps=="3"] <- 17 # triangle
ps[ps=="4"] <- 16 # round
ps <- as.numeric(ps)


### Assign linetype

lp <- as.character(values)
lp[lp=="1"] <- 5 #longdash
lp[lp=="2"] <- 1 #solid
lp[lp=="3"] <- 2 #dashed
lp[lp=="4"] <- 3 #dotted
lp <- as.numeric(lp)


### Assign Point size

pz <- as.character(values)
# pz[pz=="1"] <- 2 # for hollow diamond
pz[pz=="1"] <- 3.2
pz[pz=="2"] <- 2.3
pz[pz=="3"] <- 2.5
pz[pz=="4"] <- 2.5
pz <- as.numeric(pz)


routine<-rbind(col,ps,lp,pz)
}

a<-plotting.routine (scatter)
col<-a[1,]
ps<-as.numeric(a[2,])
lp<-as.numeric(a[3,])
pz<-as.numeric(a[4,])

scatter_sub<-scatter[scatter$treatment!=4,]
scatter_4<-scatter[scatter$treatment==4,]

scatter_4$var1<-scatter_4$change1
scatter_4$var2<-scatter_4$change2

scatter1<-scatter_4
scatter2<-scatter_4
scatter3<-scatter_4

scatter1$treatment<-1
scatter2$treatment<-2
scatter3$treatment<-3

scatter_new<-rbind(scatter1,scatter2,scatter3)


theme_new <- function (base_size = 12, base_family = "", ...){
modifyList (theme_bw (base_size = base_size, base_family =
base_family),
list (panel.grid = theme_blank(),axis.title.x =
theme_text(family = base_family,
size = base_size, vjust = 0.5)))
}

mf_labeller <- function(var, value){
value <- as.character(value)
if (var=="treatment") {
value[value=="1"] <- "1"
value[value=="2"] <- "2"
value[value=="3"] <- "3"
value[value=="4"] <- "4"
}
return(value)
}

parts:
Ian, 

You're reproducible example is a bit overwhelming. If I'm not helpful it would be a very good idea to break the problem down to the necessary component that you are struggling with so we can focus on that.

I think what you need to do is set up a separate data.frame() with your text labels. You sort of did this with "percent", but it wasn't really in a plot-able format. I recreated this in a slightly different manner and let ggplot do the hard work. You'll have to go through and replace all of the Inf/-Infs with real values so the labels don't go off the end of the plot. (Unless we can supply geom_text() with a vector of hjust/vjusts, I've never tried and I doubt it works). 

scatter2<-data.frame(SDYID=c(rep("study1", 100), rep("study2", 100)), x=rnorm(200), y=rnorm(200), treatment=c(rep(rep(seq(1:4), 25), 2)))

lillabs<-structure(list(SDYID = structure(c(1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L,
1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L,
2L), .Label = c("study1", "study2"), class = "factor"), treatment = c(1L,
1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 2L,
2L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L), Quadrant = c(1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 1L,
2L, 3L, 4L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 1L,
2L, 3L, 4L), label = structure(1:24, .Label = c("a11", "a12",
"a13", "a14", "a21", "a22", "a23", "a24", "a31", "a32", "a33",
"a34", "b11", "b12", "b13", "b14", "b21", "b22", "b23", "b24",
"b31", "b32", "b33", "b34"), class = "factor"), x = c(-Inf, Inf,
-Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf, -Inf,
Inf, -Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf),
    y = c(Inf, Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf, Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf, Inf,
    Inf, -Inf, Inf, Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf, Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf,
    Inf, Inf, -Inf)), .Names = c("SDYID", "treatment", "Quadrant",
"label", "x", "y"), class = "data.frame", row.names = c(NA, -24L
))

ggplot()+
geom_point(data=scatter2, aes(x=x, y=y))+
geom_text(data=lillabs, aes(x=x, y=y))+
facet_grid(SDYID~treatment)
